summary.name: Microsoft OneNote
summary.one_liner: Microsoft OneNote is a digital note-taking app and notebook that combines typed notes, handwritten digital ink, voice transcription, and Copilot-assisted notebooks.
use_cases: take and organize notes across devices
handwrite or sketch notes with a pen
organize lesson plans and course content
summary.what_it_does: OneNote is a cross-functional digital notebook for typing, handwriting and sketching notes, with support for digital ink so a pen can be used for sketches. Voice transcription lets users capture notes by speaking and review them later. Users can share notebooks and create content together with others. Copilot Notebooks can work from the content added to a notebook, including files, emails, and audio overviews, to help users stay caught up. A Sticky Notes feature offers quick capture and recalls notes when the user revisits the same source.
notable: Copilot Notebooks summarize files, emails and create audio overviews
Sticky Notes with automatic recall when revisiting a source
caveats: Page does not state platform-specific apps beyond web and any device
Copilot features may depend on Microsoft account or plan; page does not specify
